statement: A 0.42 kg mass oscillates on a spring while subject to a linear drag force F = -b v with b = 0.085 kg/s. The damping is weak. After how much time has the oscillation amplitude fallen to one half of its initial value?
find: Time for the amplitude to halve.
notes: A(t) = A0 exp(-b t / 2m); t_half = 2 m ln(2) / b.
